faq.q: What is the origin of Ayshat?
faq.a: Ayshat is associated with Arabic. Ayshat is the Caucasian form of Arabic عَائِشَة (ʿĀʾisha), associated with the sense 'living, prosperous'.
Yes — the underlying form عَائِشَة is Arabic.
Ayshat can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Ayshat should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. ʿĀʾisha is not a Quranic personal name.
